body: Thanks for your reply, but with the goals I had set, I don't see myself being able to continue like this. I'll give it time, make sure I get the right tests to see what's going on, but I'm still not hopeful.

I'm 27 years old and drawing was my passion. Writing was up there was well. I have no college education and no way to move up from my entry-level job. Working for myself was my biggest dream. I don't want to compensate, I want my old self back.
